title: Enterprise compliance gating and prioritization for regional data flows
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Overview: Large enterprise customers frequently submit compliance requests tied to regional data residency and contractual obligations (GDPR DPAs, APAC data localization, HIPAA controls). Current intake funnels treat these as monolithic asks which leads to slow response times, duplicated evidence collection, and missed SLA expectations.

Problem statement: We lack a consistent, risk-weighted gating mechanism that: (1) classifies a request by regulatory scope and data movement characteristics, (2) maps the ask to standardized remediation lanes (documentation, technical controls, contractual redlines), and (3) prioritizes work by customer revenue, severity, and operational cost.

Goals:
- Define a deterministic scoring model for regional data-flow compliance requests (regulatory scope, data sensitivity, contractual exposure, operational effort).
- Implement an intake playbook and UI fields that capture the minimum signals to compute the score automatically.
- Route requests into three lanes: Documentation/Evidence, Engineering Controls, Contract Negotiation & Legal.
- Surface prioritized queues to PM/RE/Support with SLA targets and ETA guidance.

Scope: This ticket covers product requirements, intake form changes, routing rules, and a lightweight scoring engine prototype. Implementation across the Console UI and support intake will be handled in a follow-up ENG ticket. Excludes end-to-end automation of evidence assembly (handled by PM-51721).

Proposal summary: Add 7 discrete fields to the compliance intake form (e.g., data types, region of storage/processing, export clauses, contract term friction, customer tier, requested SLA, legal evidence already provided). Each response maps to numeric weights and a single composite priority score. The score determines lane + suggested SLA (48h evidence, 10d engineering evaluation, 30d contract negotiation). We will publish a small playbook and a Slack workflow to triage at Triage huddles.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form updated with required fields and validation in staging
Scoring algorithm documented and deterministic for 90% of historical requests
Routing rules created that map score ranges to the three remediation lanes
Playbook published in Confluence with SLA targets and owner assignments
Dashboard card added to Console PM view showing pending high-priority regional-data requests
steps: Workshop scoring dimensions with Legal, Solutions, and Infra (owners: Legal/SE/Platform)
Draft intake UI changes and validation rules (Design -> DES-2101 will prototype)
Create scoring matrix and mapping doc in Confluence: /confluence/rwd/compliance/score-matrix
Build routing rules spec and handoff to ENG for a lightweight router prototype
Define SLA bands and communication templates for each lane
Pilot with three enterprise customers and collect feedback for two cycles
decisions: Use a static weighted-scoring model for MVP instead of ML classification to keep auditability
Prioritize contractual & data-residency signals above requested feature urgency for initial routing
Start with three remediation lanes to reduce fragmentation and align cross-functional owners
